editorial_inputs_actually_read.purpose: Audience, preservation constraints and requested editing scope.
Original passage and sole substantive basis for this proposal.

material_changes: Deleted the sentence restating that seated and standing readings were taken in different positions.
Deleted the sentence repeating the preceding distinction between a suggested reduction and an entered medication order.
Condensed the repeated uncertainty about the cause while retaining the limitation to the record.

conformance.judgment: Provisionally conforms to the brief and frozen skill.
conformance.basis: Three exact-span deletions preserve the surrounding wording and original file. The receipt completed without errors; a separate hash check confirmed that the source was unchanged and the candidate matched the receipt. Each deletion was reviewed in the complete passage, followed by a final reading for flow.
conformance.limit: Mechanical success does not establish correctness or usefulness.

correctness.judgment: Provisionally preserves the meaning of the supplied passage.
correctness.basis: The numbers, units, seated posture, standing posture, two-minute interval, previous-evening timing, reported near-fainting without reported loss of consciousness, suggested medication change, absent entered order and uncertainty in the record are retained. No diagnosis or treatment recommendation was added.
correctness.limit: No source packet or independent evidence was read. Factual truth and source fidelity remain unchecked until the separate source-check phase.

usefulness.judgment: Provisionally useful for an attentive clinician reader.
usefulness.basis: The deleted explanations repeat information already expressed explicitly. Their removal makes the retained clinical details easier to find without requiring an additional inference.
usefulness.limit: Reader benefit is an editorial judgment, not a result established by the word counts.

measurements.note: Whitespace-token alignment counts the punctuation change from unconfirmed; to unconfirmed as one removed and one inserted token; the edit plan contains deletions only. These measurements do not score authenticity or usefulness.

excluded_material: No source packets, other cases, protocol, prior reviews, memory, browsing, other writing samples or grammar-engine findings were used.
status: First proposal saved; source-check phase pending.
